Articles Module¶

Models¶

class articles.models.Article(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Model

Represents a news article in the system.

Articles are created by journalists and may optionally be linked to a publisher. Each article requires approval by an editor before being publicly visible to readers.

class articles.models.Publisher(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Model

Represents a publisher entity in the News Hub system.

Publishers can create and manage multiple articles. They act as content sources for journalist-submitted or publisher-submitted news.

Views¶

Views for the Articles app.

Handles article creation, editing, deletion, approval, and publisher management.

articles.views.approve_article(request, pk)[source]¶

Allows editors to approve an article.

Approved articles become visible to all users on the homepage.

articles.views.article_detail(request, pk)[source]¶

Displays full details of a selected article.

Includes title, content, author, publisher, and approval status.

articles.views.create_article(request)[source]¶

Allows journalists to create a new article.

Journalists can optionally assign a publisher to the article. Newly created articles are set to unapproved by default.

articles.views.delete_article(request, pk)[source]¶

Allows the author or an editor to delete an article.

Confirmation is required before permanent deletion.

articles.views.edit_article(request, pk)[source]¶

Allows the author or an editor to edit an existing article.

Updates title, content, and publisher information.

articles.views.home(request)[source]¶

Displays all approved articles on the homepage.

Only articles with approved=True are shown to users.

articles.views.logout_view(request)[source]¶

Logs the user out of the system and redirects to homepage.

articles.views.publisher_list(request)[source]¶

Allows editors to view and create publishers.

Publishers can be assigned to articles during creation or editing.
